question_text: A city ordinance prohibits discrimination in employment based on sexual orientation and gender identity (SOGIE). A private company refuses to hire a qualified applicant because of his sexual orientation, claiming the ordinance is invalid. Which of the following is the most accurate statement?

options.text: Local ordinances on anti-discrimination are invalid because only Congress can enact such laws.
The ordinance is valid because local government units have the power to protect the rights of marginalized sectors under the Local Government Code.
The ordinance is unconstitutional because it violates the company's freedom of contract.
The ordinance applies only to government offices, not private companies.
